messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 alert — SFO egress packet loss spike: 5xx/s and TCP retransmits rising on provider 'Zeta' links (sfo-edge-1/2). Threshold breached 1842102467. Pager duty: liz (oncall)

liz (oncall): I'm paged, joining. Any customer reports?

omar (neteng): seeing 20-35% packet loss across peer sessions to zeta in SFO. BGP sessions mostly up but large RTOs, some prefixes intermittently unreachable.

chen (infra): metrics show tail latency spike for hosted API egress to SFO AZs and increased 503s from inference nodes hitting external resources.

alisha (sre): also seeing DNS timeouts for requests that egress via SFO to our external DNS forwarders. Could be packet drops on path to resolver.

liz (oncall): ok, immediate mitigation plan: (1) divert traffic away from Zeta for customer-facing egress where possible, (2) raise local-pref to prefer Provider-Y for affected prefixes, (3) notify status page. Omar/Chen take network ops, I'll coordinate comms.

omar (neteng): on it. I can push local-preference change to route-map for the SFO routers. Will prefer Provider-Y by setting localpref=200 for impacted communities.

chen (infra): I'll spin up a temporary NAT egress path through SFO -> Provider-Y for services that can't easily route cross-region. Might add some capacity to avoid saturation.

alisha (sre): I'll start a customer-impact assessment. Which tenants are pinned to SFO egress? I'll run quick logs to surface top affected orgs.

omar (neteng): running: show ip bgp neighbors 203.0.113.5 advertised-routes

omar (neteng): ```
BGP neighbor 203.0.113.5 remote-as 64512
  BGP state = Established, up for 3w2d
  Received prefixes: 512
  Advertised prefixes: 480
  Flaps: 17
  1m/5m/15m input pkt drops: 0/2/5
  1m/5m/15m output pkt drops: 0/1/4
```

omar (neteng): also pulling pcap on sfo-edge-1: `tcpdump -nn -i eth0 host 203.0.113.5 and icmp` — seeing lots of retrans and ICMP unreachables from intermediate hop.

liz (oncall): good context. Omar, proceed with localpref change. Chen, can you scope the NAT detour? If it takes more than 5m tell me.

chen (infra): detour automation: applying route-policy to advertise a higher local-pref to Provider-Y for these prefix sets. K8s egress pools will flip to new path as routes converge. Pushing change now.

om ar (neteng): (typo) confirming change applied to sfo-router-01: `route-map PREFER-Y permit 10 set local-preference 200` then `clear ip bgp * soft out`

omar (neteng): route convergence starting, some ephemeral 503s expected for in-flight connections.

alisha (sre): I'm cross-referencing error counts with customer-facing endpoints. Early look: top affected customers: acme-inc, fast-pay, loomio. I'll DM account teams to escalate.

liz (oncall): Status page draft: "Partial egress packet loss affecting services with SFO egress; mitigation underway (traffic being rerouted to alternate provider)." I'll post once Omar confirms reduced loss.

oncall-bot: Incident channel created: #incident-1842102468 — primary responder: liz (oncall)

omar (neteng): loss to Zeta dropping from 30% -> 3% after localpref shift, BGP flaps still observed but reduced. Interfaces show less retrans.

chen (infra): NAT detour active. Hit-rate on the detour path is ~12% of SFO egress traffic. No CPU pressure so far.

alisha (sre): customer impact update: error rate for hosted API down from +120% to +22% over baseline. Some customers still see degraded performance. Sending targeted notifications to top 5 impacted.

liz (oncall): good. I'll update status: "Mitigation in progress — traffic being routed via alternate upstream provider, service degradation reduced. Engineers continue to monitor."

omar (neteng): follow-up checks: we should consider asking Zeta for a packet-capture on their peering facing device and opening a TAC ticket. I'll open a support case with Zeta now, attaching MTRs and pcap. Case: #ZETA-23894.

omar (neteng): ```
MTR to 8.8.8.8 via Zeta
Host            Loss%   Snt   Last   Avg  Best  Wrst StDev
1. 10.0.0.1      0.0%    20    0.6   0.9   0.4   3.1   0.6
2. 198.51.100.1  0.0%    20    1.1   1.5   0.9   7.2   1.2
3. 203.0.113.1  28.0%   20   12.4  34.2   0.9  200.5  45.1
```

alisha (sre): pager duty status: incident escalated to SEV2, oncall rotation notified. I'm adding timeline notes and initial RCA placeholders.

liz (oncall): quick question: do we keep the detour longer-term or revert once Zeta acknowledges? Omar?

omar (neteng): prefer keep detour until we confirm Zeta has a sustained fix or they announce a maintenance. We'll keep localpref change for at least 2 hours and then test reversion during low traffic window.

chen (infra): I'll keep the NAT detour available but reduce autoscale to normal after monitoring for 30m to ensure stability.

alisha (sre): notifying legal/compliance — we had a small number of requests routed differently than usual; documenting data plane changes.

liz (oncall): (to customer comms) Alisha, suggest we push a short status update to customers in the impacted org list: short, factual, and mention mitigation and that we're monitoring.

alisha (sre): message ready: "We observed elevated packet loss on one of our SFO upstream providers which caused transient errors for some requests. We've rerouted affected traffic to an alternate provider and are monitoring. No data loss suspected. We'll follow up with updates." Sending now to account teams.

omar (neteng): Zeta replied to TAC: they observed partial interface forwarding issues at their SFO POP and are applying microcode patch. ETA 40m. They asked us to keep sessions up to avoid additional churn.

liz (oncall): thanks. Let's keep sessions up and maintain localpref. I'll set a reminder to reassess in 30m.

oncall-bot: Reminder set: reassess-incident-1842102468 in 30m

alisha (sre): monitoring: error rate slowly falling to +8% above baseline. DNS timeouts resolved for most resolvers.

omar (neteng): ping loss to Zeta now 1-2%. Flaps down to 3 in last 15m. Good sign.

liz (oncall): OK — after 45m of stable reduced loss, we'll plan a controlled reversion: remove localpref override and watch for any regression. Omar lead reversion, Chen will be on standby to toggle NAT detour if needed.

alisha (sre): I've added mitigation notes to the incident doc and flagged follow-up actions: (1) full RCA w/ Zeta packet captures, (2) add more prober coverage between SFO POPs and providers, (3) update runbook for provider micro-outage.

omar (neteng): reversion started: removing `route-map PREFER-Y` from sfo-router-01 and issuing ``clear ip bgp * soft in`` to reconverge.

chen (infra): watching traffic shift now. No immediate spike in 5xxs. NAT detour still available.

alisha (sre): metrics stable. error rate back within 3% of baseline. No customer complaints in last 10m.

omar (neteng): Zeta confirms their microcode patch applied and their telemetry shows normal forwarding. They closed the TAC with note to follow up if we see reoccurence.

liz (oncall): great work. I'll post the status page update: "Service restored — egress packet loss on one upstream provider mitigated by routing and provider patching. Monitoring continues."

alisha (sre): closing notes: SEV2 -> reducing paging after 60m stable. Will convert to postmortem doc and assign owners for RCA.

liz (oncall): thanks everyone. Follow-ups: Omar to own network RCA with Zeta, Chen to update runbook, Alisha to draft postmortem. Leaving thread open until RCA doc linked.

pagerduty: Incident 1842102468 acknowledged by liz (oncall). Escalation halted.

omar (neteng): linking initial pcap and mtr traces to the incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1842102468/evidence

liz (oncall): thread summary (for handoff): 1) root cause: transient forwarding issues at Zeta SFO POP causing high packet loss, 2) mitigation: local-preference failover to Provider-Y + temporary NAT detour, 3) status: service restored, Zeta applied patch, RCA in progress.

alisha (sre): handing off to next oncall for monitoring window: @matt (oncall) — please watch metrics for 4h. I'll add him to the incident doc.

liz (oncall): handing over. Good job everyone. :thumbsup:
